subject: Terms of Use
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have moderated the blog in question. Please ensure you read the terms of use and follow the guidelines within. Please do not call out other users and try to stay positive with your posts. All opinions are welcome here, but it does help if they are constructive and if "in" jokes are kept light in nature as new users and other BurnoutAholics who may not know those involved can be put off of the site if they see hateful posts etc.

Thank you for helping make BurnoutAholics.com the most friendly of Burnout fan sites, I hope all of your continued contributions to the site help make our little community stronger.

Terms of Use

Thanks,

ZombieTron

subject: Comments Locked
author: ZombieTron
body:
Please feel free to use our PM function to continue any private conversations, however I feel everybody has been given the opportunity to say how they feel about this subject so I am now locking the comments.

Please follow the Terms of Use as I posted above, you can find these in our left hand menu for those times when you feel you need reminding of the rules here.

This site is controlled, and right now it is being controlled by a 6 months pregnant lady with limited patience and raging hormones, so please be nice, play nice, play the games we all love and try to remember what we have in common as opposed to always focussing on the negative differences between us.

Thanks,

ZombieTron

subject: But the Hanicap is part of the game
author: SUFFUR
body:
And thats what it is, a game, and it's supposed to be fun, and I can agree with most agruments that Paradise racing is not fun, and the traffic is the handicap and the TD phiz, and the lag and syncing of players and traffic and timelines too and stupid crash glitches! But since it effects everyone we put up with it like the handicap in Revenge with it's crap TD Phiz. And we all drive real cars Rofer, have been for 30 years for some of us (but when I have too, not Sunday driving, as that is just a waste of fuel), but rather save money driving on a game, sort of ecco friendlyish, well better than oil use anyway, which people don't get when the oil runs out no consoles, no clothes, no medicine (no not all of them some are made from caulk (sp) and willow bark), because we will use it all up in combustion engines, what a waste.

Anyway Tangent, and you admit you have nothing good/nice to say so why bother? We all know you hate Paradise, but do you have to come back and repeat the same stuff again and again, you don't even list the problems you find wrong, like a programmer, let alone like a player?

So I can see why Kev would go ape on you, I would too, but then it's just a game, and this is just a fan site, if your not a fan why show up in the first place.

Don't get me wrong you got m4d 3l173 skills for Revenge, but is that your net worth, and the same with Jinno, you even said I just like to talk trash rather than play, maybe a talk show/podcast would be better suited rather than playing games on a electronic media.

It seems because no Revenege 2 came out, it has become a hate fest, to something that is already 1 and 1/2 years old, and the only people that should be qualified to dis Paradise is the people playing it?

You had your say, plagerised as it was Rofer, so why add fuel to a fire that was supposed to gone out for Revengers, so long ago?

Revenge could of had a lease of life if there some positive feedback, but all I saw was, Paradise sux, Revenge for ever even with it's flaws, then again how long would people be playing it if there was no boost jump bug? Or the lack of Handicap, no tight racing to be had.

Not me for starters, and if the comms was working on BO3 I would still be there, it had more tracks, better TD phiz, and no-one gets bored of 6 laps of tropical drive in a road rage? (and yes Sonic I would play it on purpose if it worked, lol, it did for BO3!)

Someone said the Around Paradise was equal to 2 tracks the other day, thats what I find odd about Paradise it  is so small, that even noobs think Around Paradise is an event too long???

Anyway back on topic, a game is designed for a specified purpose and we have to abide by what has been created, live with it, don't with it, complain, don't but if you are, back it up by at least playing it through and talking about what issuses you have. Then again why should you, you only care about the fun of winning on Revenge?

I can't believe I have come back to "Rofer hates paradise" comments, you really stir it up dude, same with you Jinno, why bother, as it does not really stimulate postive feed back.

And Jwillisjr, this site is fine, so are the fans and haters lol, but we all hoped Paradise was better, it's a good game, but it not outstanding like it's predisessors (sp) it good for so much and so far, but the only people that should bytch about it is it's players not its haters, as they walked away from it a year and a half ago!

And I had the worsed racing on a game for the last 4 days, only won 2 races and only one counted and that was in the Paradise Cup S 1, roll on the Second season, with the added island it may be different, but we will see, when we coughed up the do'h!

This site was started, (i missed an 't' in a previous one I'm sure), by Xandu for his friends from Burnout meet ups to look at picture of our selves getting dessip, lol, (and I also think he did it because he Loves Zombie, because she is the biggest with Bump, and bestest fan of all Burnout games and Criterio, and yes Alex I will never forget what you said) and has gone on to be a great site about the burnout games and Criterion, not that they like us, but it was people like us that made them popular in the first place, since Revenge, there are at least 20 plus sites dedicated to some form of Paradise game play, but only a few sites that stick to all the Burnout games, Xandu has FAQ's that cover so much it's scary intensive. And he has done amazing work, hard work, in his own time for free, well some donations, but mostly for free, and they let me get away with murder maybe? Though character assassination is moderated, lol.

I remember when Xandu and Zom went to Criterion, what day that was for them, me and thier friends, and when Pardise came out, most went WTF! Where were they going with it? They left what was great about the game to just driving about, ok, fine, and some stayed because it was so different, and some went crying on about it, like me, but I still played and payed for it and all the GCC/DLC, except the Party Pack, if it was online maybe I would have got it, anyway I seem to be repeating myself like you Rofer, but at least I wrote more than a sentence or a short forum paragraph, that was in my own words and not 'yeah what he said' though your last couple were good, and seemed like original words, you weren't told what to write were you? LOL.

I think because of the new generation of consoles, which brings new customers/players so new that they don't even know what went on before to get to Paradise, and that is fine because this site shows Criterion's past games, though why anyone one would play Revenge because if seems to be full of Elite haters, why play with people that have their noses in the air, because Paradise was not what they wanted.

I am glad you are learning to be programmer Rofer, get on with it and create Revenge Type 2, it should keep you so busy you should not be able to post some of the rubbish you do come up with. And when it's done, send me a copy 4 free, and I hope, and better like it? Because you know what could happen I could turn in to you, and Bytch Bytch Bytch, but I hope not, I hope it will be awesum, and then I will know the best car racing arcade programmer out there, and i MIGHT THEN COME AND FIND YOU AND BUY YOU A BEER!  I would be easy to spot, I'm an Inch taller and better looking even with my hair falling out, lol.

So shut up and make that game, and put some time into it, really study hard it will pay off, you should not have anytime to play Revenge either, as you have a huge task to do and a lot of fans to please!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

And another pointless comment brought to you by suf, and that bit inbetween each second  that counts too!

And since I took so long to write this I probably missed something, lol
